# M0 test assets (migration regression safety net)

Built per `docs/migration/05-regression-test-plan.md` §1. Native Swift tests
read this directory by relative path (zero sharing cost once the `native/`
project exists in this repository).

## Frozen vs regenerated

The Flutter app was removed from this repository on 2026-11-15 (Android is
dropped permanently; the iOS-native rewrite in `native/` replaces the
Flutter app). Payloads that only Flutter code could produce can never be
regenerated, so they are **frozen and tracked in git**, pinned to the
Flutter app `1.2.1+38`. The last commit that could rebuild them was
`a48c34d` (branch `native`); from there the Flutter tree can be restored if
a regeneration is ever truly needed.

| Payload (TRACKED, frozen) | Why it cannot be regenerated |
| --- | --- |
| `db/**` — db_light/heavy/user/dirty/v3/crashed/corrupt ×3/edge_subs/smoke + cache meta DBs + tmp audio | produced by `test/fixtures/generate_db_fixtures_test.dart`, which ran the app's real table creators, models and insertion algorithms over the corpus; `db_user` = the author's real subscription set (stands in for a device pull, 05 §1.1 fallback c); `db_smoke` = the reproducible `-m2-smoke-play` container (player pointer set, cached head with in-file progress, far-future validTill — 2026-09-23 correction for an unreproducible earlier record) |
| `db/db_device/` — real iOS container | `integration_test/m0_seed_test.dart` booted the real Flutter app on a simulator, imported the author's 25 subscriptions via the real share-dialog path, queued episodes, and played one; the container was pulled during the test's hold window (`xcrun simctl get_app_container`). Includes the real audio cache at `Library/Caches/anycast_episode/` |
| `opml/app_export.opml` | produced by the app's real `generateOPML` via the same Dart generator |

Everything below is still **regenerated from its recorded sources** and
therefore gitignored (restore a machine with `tool/m0/regen_all.sh --live`):

| Payload (gitignored) | Source of record | Regenerated by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rss/**/*.xml` — live buckets (standard / http_plain / redirect / ua_sensitive) | `rss/manifest.json` + `*.headers.txt` (url, sha256, captured_at, content type) + `tool/m0/feeds_curated.txt` | `tool/m0/fetch_rss.sh` |
| `rss/user_subs/*.xml` — the author's real subscription export | `rss/user_subs/manifest.json` + `*.headers.txt` + `tool/m0/feeds_user.txt` (source OPML's xmlUrls) | `tool/m0/fetch_user_subs.sh` |
| `rss/{missing_fields,giant,malformed,weird_dates}/*.xml` — constructed buckets | fixed seed + first `standard` manifest entry as template | `tool/m0/construct_rss_buckets.py` |
| `channels_index.json` | derived from the live corpus (385-feed channel index) | `tool/m0/fetch_rss.sh` |
| `api/**` — 10 endpoints × success+error branches | every URL and constructed body lives verbatim in the collector | `tool/m0/fetch_api.sh` |
| `audio/**` — 8s..2h05m samples, silence, VBR, AAC, garbage | deterministic ffmpeg recipes | `tool/m0/fetch_media.sh` |
| `opml/{overcast,xiaoyuzhou,giant_500}.opml` | constructed from `channels_index.json` | `tool/m0/fetch_media.sh` |
| `images/**` — 8 real covers | cover URLs in `channels_index.json` (first 8 with image) | `tool/m0/fetch_media.sh` |

Tracked in git:

- `test/fixtures/db/**` and `opml/app_export.opml` — the frozen
  Flutter-generated payloads above (never edit them; their bytes are the
  released-app evidence the native suites verify against).
- `test/fixtures/rss/**/manifest.json` and `rss/**/*.headers.txt` — capture
  records; the `sha256` fields let you audit drift after re-collecting.
- `test/golden/` — G1–G16 + G_palette expectations exported from the old
  implementation's real logic (pinned to 1.2.1+38; frozen since the
  exporter `test/golden/export_golden_test.dart` was removed with the
  Flutter app — see `test/golden/manifest.json`).
- `tool/m0/` collectors/generators and this README.

## Regeneration

```bash
tool/m0/regen_all.sh          # offline: reconstruct the deterministic
                              # buckets (constructed rss, audio, opml) from
                              # the corpus materialized on this machine
tool/m0/regen_all.sh --live   # re-collect the live corpus first (network:
                              # rss + api + covers), then reconstruct
```

On a fresh clone the regenerated payloads are absent **by design** —
bootstrap once with `--live` (needs network, ffmpeg, python3). The frozen
payloads (`db/**`, `opml/app_export.opml`) arrive with the clone. Live
content drifts over time, so `--live` also refreshes every capture record
derived from it; the manifest `sha256` values record which bytes each
golden was cut against.

Error-path audio URLs: serve locally with
`python3 tool/m0/serve_local.py test/fixtures/audio` (URLs listed in
`audio/error_urls.txt`).

## Notes

- The historical note stands for any future generator: a generator must
  live OUTSIDE its output directory (a past generator inside
  `test/fixtures/db/` deleted its own source during cleanup).
- Cache meta databases really use columns
  `_id/url/key/relativePath/eTag/validTill/touched/length` (`relativePath`
  stores only the file name, resolved via `<tmp>/<cacheKey>/`) — corrects the
  older "path" wording in `docs/migration/01` §1.2.
